text:
maria: quick ask — can someone run a short overnight SKU compare for v2-small (2k ctx) across A100/H100/L40S? need p50/p95 tokens/s and end-to-end gen latency for batch sizes 1,4,8. please keep model build and quant fixed (int8), and include cold vs warm cache when possible. aiming for a quick callout if anything odd shows up in tail latency.

jamie: I can take this. which runtime image + quant config you want me to use? and any special nvlink settings?

maria: use redwood/runtime:v3.2.1 + int8-quant-profile=fast-latency. NVLINK: default cluster network. important: same seed and prompt set (shared in infra bucket). goal is a 6h sweep overnight.

kai: tagging infra — @kai can you confirm we have at least one A100, H100, and L40S free in zone-us-west-2 for overnight? also enable perf counters (nvprof/ncu) sampling.

kai: confirmed, I reserved 1x A100-80GB, 1x H100-80GB, 2x L40S. I set power limit to factory defaults. Perf counters enabled. will flip MIG off on the A100 node. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: queued job #4852: sku-sweep v2-small batches=[1,4,8] quant=int8 image=redwood/runtime:v3.2.1. ETA run start in 25m.

jamie: running now. command I used:
```bash
./run_sku_bench.sh --model v2-small --ctx 2048 --batches 1,4,8 --quant int8 --image redwood/runtime:v3.2.1 --output s3://redwood-bench/sku/nightcap/1735678901/
```

jamie: quick note — I disabled async-prefetch on the L40S for stability. left it on for A100/H100.

maria: ok good, please post raw p50/p95 and a one-line summary when done. :eyes:

(overnight)

bench-bot: job #4852 finished. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/sku/nightcap/1735678901/ (logs + csv)

jamie: preliminary numbers (cold cache -> warm cache):
- A100 (p50 tokens/s): 4200 -> 6300, p95 latency (ms/token): 0.85 -> 0.6
- H100 (p50 tokens/s): 4900 -> 7300, p95 latency (ms/token): 0.78 -> 0.55
- L40S (p50 tokens/s): 3800 -> 5900, p95 latency (ms/token): 1.2 -> 0.9
(above are batch=4 numbers; batch1 and batch8 attached in CSV)

jamie: interesting: L40S shows a pronounced tail at batch=8 with cold cache — p95 jumped to ~2.1 ms/token and we saw several kernel requeues in the logs.

ashley: could be NVSwitch pressure or driver fallback. do we have memory ECC events?

jamie: no ECC events in dmesg. kernel logs show repeated TLB shootdowns around the same windows as the tail. attaching snippet:
```
[info] kernel: mmu: tlb flush helpers triggered 12 times
[warn] runtime: kernel_requeue_count=8 at 03:14:22
```

kai: L40S node had mixed PCIe topology (two GPUs on same root complex). I can repro the batch8 tail if you want — try running with PCIe peer-to-peer disabled or set GPU affinity to a single device. Might be cross-device DMA thrash.

maria: next action: jamie, rerun L40S batch8 with p2p disabled and with async-prefetch on/off and post both logs. keep rest the same. also include a run with `--tiny-batch warm-cache` behavior (simulate persistent KV warm cache).

jamie: will do. ETA a couple hours. scheduling now.

bench-bot: queued job #4863 (L40S diagnostic, p2p off, batches=8, tiny-warm variants).

jamie: diag run done. summary:
- L40S batch8 p95 (p2p on): 2.1 ms/token
- L40S batch8 p95 (p2p off): 1.05 ms/token
- L40S batch8 p95 (p2p off + tiny-warm): 0.95 ms/token
logs: s3://redwood-bench/sku/nightcap/1735678901/diag/

maria: nice, that strongly points at PCIe p2p causing interference. Kai, can infra standardize p2p settings or at least document topology?

kai: yes, I'll add a note to the cluster runbook and mark the L40S pool as "p2p-disabled-by-default" for inference workloads with small batches. also will add an automated check in node-provisioner.

ashley: good catch. for shipping notes, we should call out L40S has comparable throughput but higher sensitivity to cross-GPU traffic for batchy workloads.

maria: agreed. final ask — jamie, drop a one-paragraph summary + link to CSV in the PR for runtime tuning so product folks can see numbers. keep it short. :rocket:

jamie: done — PR #1284 created with summary and CSV link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1284 (includes command, artifacts, and recommended p2p=false for L40S).

maria: thanks all. closing this thread, will follow up in the runbook. :thumbsup:
